classes.class_summary: DevicesMFE is a page class for managing device-related UI interactions in the Smart web flow. It provides verification methods to check the presence of various UI elements (popups, navigation bars, device cards, panels) and action methods to interact with these elements (clicking buttons, refreshing, navigating). The class handles HPX What's New popup flows, device management, and user authentication states.
